profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-based public company, traded as HSAI, that describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and in lidar solutions for ADAS and autonomous mobility. According to its own site, its lidar sensors are used in ADAS, autonomous vehicles, trucking, robotics, and industrial applications, and the company says it partners with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle, and robotics companies worldwide, with mass-produced lidars delivered to customers in over 40 countries. It frames lidar as the eyes of intelligent vehicles, providing high-resolution 3D perception that enables features such as AEB (Automated Emergency Braking) and NOA (Navigation on Autopilot), and says its sensors meet the standards for L4+ autonomous driving used by robotaxis and robobuses.

The material available on the company's own site is largely positioning rather than product specifics: it presents itself as an expert in lidar technology and a leading lidar manufacturer, and describes its aim of enabling physical AI across ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence. No individual products, named customers, or executives appear in the available text.

The held record adds that Hesai Group is a registrant with the SEC under CIK 0001861737, with headquarters in Shanghai and a for-profit public company status. No litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are recorded.
